overall_rationale: All three must needs (N1, N2, N3) can be served but all require conditions. N1 (daily sales) has a 34-day gap due to till migration and a product-code discontinuity requiring name-based matching. N2 (product code mapping) is only partially met because no mapping table exists and some product names are not unique, so the mapping will be incomplete. N3 (daily max temperature) requires a paid commercial subscription to Open-Meteo. The must needs drive the verdict: N1 and N3 are met_with_conditions (achievable), and N2 is partially_met (mapping via name with non-unique names is the best possible). The should-priority needs (N4, N5) are fully met. No blocker-severity flags are triggered on any source serving must needs. The conditions are actionable.

need_coverage.gap: Daily sales data exists for both windows. However: (1) 34-day gap from 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 (till migration) has no recorded data. (2) Product code change on 2024-04-01 with no mapping table means cross-period analysis requires name matching, which is unreliable for non-unique product names.

No mapping table exists between old (L-ending, pre-2024) and new (post-2024) product codes (wiki product_codes_2024). Matching by product name is possible but some names are not unique, making the mapping incomplete. Manual reconciliation with shop owner may help but some ambiguity remains.

Daily max temperature data covers both windows fully at daily grain from ERA5 reanalysis. Condition: a paid commercial subscription is required since Valdena is a commercial entity and the free tier is non-commercial only. Attribution under CC BY 4.0 must be provided.
